+from itertools import product, combinations

+def dependency_solver(preference, name_order):
+    def solve(data):
+        packages = data["packages"]
+        names = sorted(packages)
+        order = names if name_order == "ascending" else list(reversed(names))
+        features = set(data.get("features", []))
+        blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+        pins = data.get("pins", {})
+        choices = [[-1] + [row["version"] for row in packages[name]] for name in names]
+        best_vector = None
+        best_versions = None
+        for values in product(*choices):
+            assignment = dict(zip(names, values))
+            selected = {n for n, v in assignment.items() if v != -1}
+            rows = {n: next((r for r in packages[n] if r["version"] == assignment[n]), None)
+                    for n in selected}
+            valid = True
+            for name, bounds in data["roots"].items():
+                version = assignment.get(name, -1)
+                if version == -1 or not bounds[0] <= version <= bounds[1]:
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+            if not valid:
+                continue
+            edges = {n: [] for n in selected}
+            for name in selected:
+                row = rows[name]
+                version = row["version"]
+                if version in blocked.get(name, []) or (name in pins and version != pins[name]):
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+                for dep in row.get("deps", []):
+                    feature = dep.get("feature", "")
+                    if feature and feature not in features:
+                        continue
+                    target = dep["name"]
+                    target_version = assignment.get(target, -1)
+                    if target_version == -1 or not dep["min"] <= target_version <= dep["max"]:
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                    edges[name].append(target)
+                if not valid:
+                    break
+            if not valid:
+                continue
+            reached = set()
+            stack = list(data["roots"])
+            while stack:
+                name = stack.pop()
+                if name in reached:
+                    continue
+                reached.add(name)
+                stack.extend(edges.get(name, []))
+            if reached != selected:
+                continue
+            finished, active = set(), set()
+            def visit(name):
+                if name in active:
+                    return False
+                if name in finished:
+                    return True
+                active.add(name)
+                if any(not visit(other) for other in edges[name]):
+                    return False
+                active.remove(name)
+                finished.add(name)
+                return True
+            if not all(visit(name) for name in selected):
+                continue
+            vector = tuple(assignment[n] for n in order)
+            if best_vector is None or (vector < best_vector if preference == "minimum" else vector > best_vector):
+                best_vector = vector
+                best_versions = {n: assignment[n] for n in selected}
+        return {"versions": best_versions} if best_versions is not None else {"error": "unsatisfiable"}

+def _routes(data):
+    n = data["n"]
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bit_for = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    start_node = data["source"]
+    initial_mask = bit_for.get(start_node, 0)
+    coupons = data["coupons"]
+    deadline = data["deadline"]
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(n)]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    start = data["start"]
+    initial = (start_node, initial_mask, 0)
+    best = {initial: start}
+    queue = [(start, start_node, initial_mask, 0)]
+    while queue:
+        time, node, mask, used = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, used)
+        if best.get(state) != time:
+            continue
+        if node == data["target"] and mask == full and used == coupons:
+            return {"arrival": time}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(time, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            for spend in (0, 1):
+                if used + spend > coupons:
+                    continue
+                duration = edge["duration"]
+                if spend:
+                    duration = max(1, duration - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                arrival = depart + duration
+                if arrival > deadline:

+def _route(data, exact, minimum_duration):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bit = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    source, target = data["source"], data["target"]
+    initial_mask = bit.get(source, 0)
+    start = data["start"]
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    # A state includes every property affecting future feasibility.
+    initial = (source, initial_mask, 0)
+    best = {initial: start}
+    queue = [(start, source, initial_mask, 0)]
+    while queue:
+        time, node, mask, used = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, used)
+        if best.get(state) != time:
+            continue
+        if (node == target and mask == full and
+                (used == data["coupons"] if exact else True)):
+            return {"arrival": time}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(time, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            options = [(depart + edge["duration"], used)]
+            if used < data["coupons"]:
+                duration = max(minimum_duration,
+                               edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                options.append((depart + duration, used + 1))
+            for arrival, next_used in options:
+                if arrival > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                next_node = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask | bit.get(next_node, 0)
+                next_state = (next_node, next_mask, next_used)
+                if arrival < best.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    best[next_state] = arrival
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (arrival, next_node, next_mask, next_used))
+    return {"arrival": None}

+import heapq
+import itertools
+from collections import Counter

+def _temporal(data, coupon_rule, minimum_duration):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bit = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    initial_mask = bit.get(data["source"], 0)
+    coupons = data["coupons"]
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    # State includes every resource that can affect future feasibility.
+    start_state = (data["source"], initial_mask, 0)
+    best = {start_state: data["start"]}
+    queue = [(data["start"], data["source"], initial_mask, 0)]
+    while queue:
+        arrival, node, mask, used = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, used)
+        if best.get(state) != arrival:
+            continue
+        if node == data["target"] and mask == full and (
+                coupon_rule == "at_most" or used == coupons):
+            return {"arrival": arrival}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(arrival, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            options = [(edge["duration"], used)]
+            if used < coupons:
+                duration = max(minimum_duration,
+                               edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                options.append((duration, used + 1))
+            for duration, next_used in options:
+                next_time = depart + duration
+                if next_time > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                next_node = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask | bit.get(next_node, 0)
+                next_state = (next_node, next_mask, next_used)
+                if next_time < best.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    best[next_state] = next_time
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (next_time, next_node,
+                                           next_mask, next_used))
+    return {"arrival": None}
+

+def _route(data, minimum_duration, exact):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bits = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    source, target = data["source"], data["target"]
+    limit = data["coupons"]
+    start = (source, bits.get(source, 0), 0)
+    best = {start: data["start"]}
+    queue = [(data["start"], source, bits.get(source, 0), 0)]
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    while queue:
+        time, node, mask, used = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, used)
+        if best.get(state) != time:
+            continue
+        if (node == target and mask == full and
+                (used == limit if exact else True)):
+            return {"arrival": time}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(time, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            options = [(edge["duration"], used)]
+            if used < limit:
+                duration = max(minimum_duration,
+                               edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                options.append((duration, used + 1))
+            for duration, next_used in options:
+                arrival = depart + duration
+                if arrival > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                nxt = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask | bits.get(nxt, 0)
+                next_state = (nxt, next_mask, next_used)
+                if arrival < best.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    best[next_state] = arrival
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (arrival, nxt, next_mask, next_used))
+    return {"arrival": None}

+def _routes(data):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bits = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    source = data["source"]
+    initial_mask = bits.get(source, 0)
+    coupons = data["coupons"]
+    start = data["start"]
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    initial = (source, initial_mask, coupons)
+    best = {initial: start}
+    queue = [(start, source, initial_mask, coupons)]
+    while queue:
+        time, node, mask, left = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, left)
+        if best.get(state) != time:
+            continue
+        if node == data["target"] and mask == full and left == 0:
+            return {"arrival": time}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(time, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            choices = [(edge["duration"], left)]
+            if left:
+                choices.append((max(2, edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0)),
+                                left - 1))
+            next_mask = mask | bits.get(edge["v"], 0)
+            for duration, next_left in choices:
+                arrival = depart + duration
+                if arrival > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                next_state = (edge["v"], next_mask, next_left)
+                if arrival < best.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    best[next_state] = arrival
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (arrival, edge["v"], next_mask,
+                                           next_left))

+def _routes(data):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bits = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]

+    distances = {initial_state: data["start"]}
+    queue = [(data["start"], source, initial_mask, coupons)]

+    while queue:
+        time, node, mask, left = heapq.heappop(queue)

+def _quota_intervals(data, capacity, tie):
+    jobs = data["jobs"]
+    k = data["k"]
+    blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+
+    for chosen in combinations(jobs, k):
+        ids = tuple(sorted(job["id"] for job in chosen))
+        id_set = set(ids)
+        if not mandatory.issubset(id_set) or blocked.intersection(id_set):
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in chosen:
+            counts[job["group"]] = counts.get(job["group"], 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+               for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+
+        active = []
+        valid = True
+        for job in sorted(chosen, key=lambda row: (row["start"], row["end"])):
+            while active and active[0] <= job["start"]:
+                heapq.heappop(active)
+            if len(active) >= capacity:
+                valid = False
+                break
+            heapq.heappush(active, job["end"])
+        if not valid:
+            continue
+
+        value = sum(job["value"] for job in chosen)

+        if best_value is None or value > best_value or (value == best_value and better_tie):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, ids
+
+    if best_ids is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": list(best_ids), "value": best_value}

+def _dependency_solver(data, preference, name_order):
+    packages = data["packages"]
+    names = sorted(packages)
+    roots = data["roots"]
+    features = set(data.get("features", []))
+    blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+    pins = data.get("pins", {})
+    rows_by_name = {
+        name: {row["version"]: row for row in rows}
+        for name, rows in packages.items()
+    }
+    best_vector = None
+    best_versions = None
+
+    for assignment in product(*[[-1] + list(rows_by_name[name]) for name in names]):
+        versions = {name: version for name, version in zip(names, assignment)
+                    if version != -1}
+        if any(name not in versions or not low <= versions[name] <= high
+               for name, (low, high) in roots.items()):
+            continue
+        if any(version in blocked.get(name, []) for name, version in versions.items()):
+            continue
+        if any(versions[name] != pin for name, pin in pins.items()
+               if name in versions):
+            continue
+
+        edges = {name: [] for name in versions}
+        valid = True
+        for name, version in versions.items():
+            row = rows_by_name[name][version]
+            for dep in row.get("deps", []):
+                feature = dep.get("feature", "")
+                if feature and feature not in features:
+                    continue
+                target = dep["name"]
+                if (target not in versions or
+                        not dep["min"] <= versions[target] <= dep["max"]):
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+                edges[name].append(target)
+            if not valid:
+                break
+        if not valid:
+            continue
+
+        # Installed packages must be precisely the dependency closure of roots.
+        reachable = set()
+        stack = list(roots)
+        while stack:
+            name = stack.pop()
+            if name in reachable:
+                continue
+            reachable.add(name)
+            stack.extend(edges[name])
+        if reachable != set(versions):
+            continue
+
+        state, acyclic = {}, True
+
+        def visit(name):
+            nonlocal acyclic
+            if state.get(name) == 1:
+                acyclic = False
+                return
+            if state.get(name) == 2:
+                return
+            state[name] = 1
+            for target in edges[name]:
+                visit(target)
+                if not acyclic:
+                    return
+            state[name] = 2
+
+        for name in versions:
+            visit(name)
+            if not acyclic:
+                break

+            continue

+            best_versions = versions

+def _dependency_solver(name_order, preference):
+    def solve(data):
+        packages = data["packages"]
+        features = set(data.get("features", []))
+        blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+        pins = data.get("pins", {})
+        names = sorted(packages, reverse=(name_order == "descending"))
+        best_vector = None
+        best = None
+
+        def acyclic(edges):
+            visiting, done = set(), set()
+
+            def visit(name):
+                if name in visiting:
+                    return False
+                if name in done:
+                    return True
+                visiting.add(name)
+                if any(not visit(child) for child in edges.get(name, [])):
+                    return False
+                visiting.remove(name)
+                done.add(name)
+                return True
+
+            return all(visit(name) for name in edges)
+
+        def search(chosen, bounds, edges):
+            nonlocal best, best_vector
+            remaining = [name for name in bounds if name not in chosen]
+            if not remaining:
+                if not acyclic(edges):
+                    return
+                vector = tuple(chosen.get(name, -1) for name in names)
+                if (best_vector is None or
+                        (vector < best_vector if preference == "minimum" else vector > best_vector)):
+                    best_vector = vector
+                    best = dict(chosen)
+                return
+
+            name = min(remaining)
+            low, high = bounds[name]
+            rows = [row for row in packages[name]
+                    if low <= row["version"] <= high
+                    and row["version"] not in blocked.get(name, [])
+                    and (name not in pins or row["version"] == pins[name])]
+            rows.sort(key=lambda row: row["version"], reverse=(preference == "maximum"))
+            for row in rows:
+                version = row["version"]
+                next_chosen = dict(chosen)
+                next_bounds = dict(bounds)
+                next_edges = dict(edges)
+                next_chosen[name] = version
+                active = [dep for dep in row.get("deps", [])
+                          if not dep.get("feature") or dep["feature"] in features]
+                next_edges[name] = [dep["name"] for dep in active]
+                valid = True
+                for dep in active:
+                    child = dep["name"]
+                    dep_low, dep_high = dep["min"], dep["max"]
+                    old_low, old_high = next_bounds.get(child, (1, 9))
+                    new_low, new_high = max(old_low, dep_low), min(old_high, dep_high)
+                    if new_low > new_high:
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                    next_bounds[child] = (new_low, new_high)
+                    if child in next_chosen and not new_low <= next_chosen[child] <= new_high:
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                if valid:
+                    search(next_chosen, next_bounds, next_edges)
+
+        roots = {name: (bounds[0], bounds[1]) for name, bounds in data["roots"].items()}
+        search({}, roots, {})
+        if best is None:
+            return {"error": "unsatisfiable"}
+        return {"versions": best}
+
+    return solve

+def _dependency_solver(data, preference, name_order):
+    packages = data["packages"]
+    names = sorted(packages, reverse=(name_order == "descending"))
+    roots = data["roots"]
+    features = set(data.get("features", []))
+    blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+    pins = data.get("pins", {})
+    options = [[None] + [row["version"] for row in packages[name]]
+               for name in names]
+    best_vector = None
+    best = None
+
+    for choices in product(*options):
+        selected = {name: version for name, version in zip(names, choices)
+                    if version is not None}
+        if any(name not in selected or not bounds[0] <= selected[name] <= bounds[1]
+               for name, bounds in roots.items()):
+            continue
+        if any(version in blocked.get(name, []) for name, version in selected.items()):
+            continue
+        if any(name in selected and selected[name] != version
+               for name, version in pins.items()):
+            continue
+
+        edges = {name: [] for name in selected}
+        valid = True
+        for name, version in selected.items():
+            row = next(row for row in packages[name] if row["version"] == version)
+            for dep in row.get("deps", []):
+                feature = dep.get("feature")
+                if feature and feature not in features:
+                    continue
+                target = dep["name"]
+                if target not in selected or not dep["min"] <= selected[target] <= dep["max"]:
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+                edges[name].append(target)
+            if not valid:
+                break
+        if not valid:
+            continue
+
+        reachable = set()
+        stack = list(roots)
+        while stack:
+            name = stack.pop()
+            if name in reachable:
+                continue
+            reachable.add(name)
+            stack.extend(edges[name])
+        if reachable != set(selected):
+            continue
+
+        state = {}
+        def acyclic(name):
+            if state.get(name) == 1:
+                return False
+            if state.get(name) == 2:
+                return True
+            state[name] = 1
+            if any(not acyclic(other) for other in edges[name]):
+                return False
+            state[name] = 2
+            return True
+
+        if not all(acyclic(name) for name in selected):
+            continue
+        vector = tuple(selected.get(name, -1) for name in names)
+        if (best_vector is None or
+                (vector < best_vector if preference == "minimum" else vector > best_vector)):
+            best_vector = vector
+            best = selected

+def _dependency_solver(preference, name_order):
+    def solve(data):
+        packages = data["packages"]
+        names = sorted(packages)
+        if name_order == "descending":
+            names.reverse()
+        features = set(data.get("features", []))
+        blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+        pins = data.get("pins", {})
+        choices = [[None] + list(packages[name]) for name in names]
+        best_key = None
+        best_versions = None
+
+        for assignment in product(*choices):
+            selected = {name: row for name, row in zip(names, assignment) if row is not None}
+            valid = True
+            for name, bounds in data["roots"].items():
+                row = selected.get(name)
+                if row is None or not bounds[0] <= row["version"] <= bounds[1]:
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+            if not valid:
+                continue
+
+            reached = set()
+            edges = {}
+            pending = list(data["roots"])
+            while pending and valid:
+                name = pending.pop()
+                if name in reached:
+                    continue
+                reached.add(name)
+                row = selected.get(name)
+                if row is None:
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+                version = row["version"]
+                if version in blocked.get(name, []) or (name in pins and pins[name] != version):
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+                active = [dep for dep in row.get("deps", [])
+                          if not dep.get("feature") or dep["feature"] in features]
+                edges[name] = []
+                for dep in active:
+                    other = dep["name"]
+                    child = selected.get(other)
+                    if child is None or not dep["min"] <= child["version"] <= dep["max"]:
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                    edges[name].append(other)
+                    pending.append(other)
+            if not valid or reached != set(selected):
+                continue
+
+            finished, active_nodes = set(), set()
+            def visit(node):
+                if node in active_nodes:
+                    return False
+                if node in finished:
+                    return True
+                active_nodes.add(node)
+                if any(not visit(child) for child in edges.get(node, [])):
+                    return False
+                active_nodes.remove(node)
+                finished.add(node)
+                return True
+            if not all(visit(node) for node in edges):
+                continue
+
+            vector = tuple(selected[n]["version"] if n in selected else -1 for n in names)
+            if best_key is None or (vector < best_key if preference == "minimum" else vector > best_key):
+                best_key = vector
+                best_versions = {n: row["version"] for n, row in selected.items()}
+        if best_versions is None:
+            return {"error": "unsatisfiable"}
+        return {"versions": best_versions}
+    return solve

+def _dependency_solver(preference, name_order):
+    def solve(data):
+        packages = data["packages"]
+        features = set(data.get("features", []))
+        blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+        pins = data.get("pins", {})
+        names = sorted(packages, reverse=(name_order == "descending"))
+        best = None
+        best_vector = None
+
+        def search(chosen, constraints, edges):
+            nonlocal best, best_vector
+            pending = [name for name in constraints if name not in chosen]
+            if not pending:
+                # Reject cycles in the selected dependency graph.
+                done, active = set(), set()
+
+                def visit(name):
+                    if name in active:
+                        return False
+                    if name in done:
+                        return True
+                    active.add(name)
+                    if any(not visit(child) for child in edges.get(name, [])):
+                        return False
+                    active.remove(name)
+                    done.add(name)
+                    return True
+
+                if not all(visit(name) for name in chosen):
+                    return
+                vector = tuple(chosen.get(name, -1) for name in names)
+                if best_vector is None or (
+                    vector > best_vector if preference == "maximum"
+                    else vector < best_vector
+                ):
+                    best_vector = vector
+                    best = dict(chosen)
+                return
+
+            # Any unresolved name is valid; this deterministic choice only affects search order.
+            name = min(pending)
+            low, high = constraints[name]
+            rows = [row for row in packages[name]
+                    if low <= row["version"] <= high
+                    and row["version"] not in blocked.get(name, [])
+                    and (name not in pins or row["version"] == pins[name])]
+            rows.sort(key=lambda row: row["version"], reverse=(preference == "maximum"))
+            for row in rows:
+                version = row["version"]
+                new_chosen = dict(chosen)
+                new_chosen[name] = version
+                new_constraints = dict(constraints)
+                new_edges = {key: list(value) for key, value in edges.items()}
+                children = []
+                valid = True
+                for dep in row.get("deps", []):
+                    feature = dep.get("feature", "")
+                    if feature and feature not in features:
+                        continue
+                    child = dep["name"]
+                    children.append(child)
+                    bounds = (dep["min"], dep["max"])
+                    if child in new_constraints:
+                        old = new_constraints[child]
+                        bounds = (max(old[0], bounds[0]), min(old[1], bounds[1]))
+                    if bounds[0] > bounds[1]:
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                    new_constraints[child] = bounds
+                    if child in new_chosen and not (bounds[0] <= new_chosen[child] <= bounds[1]):
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                if valid:
+                    new_edges[name] = children
+                    search(new_chosen, new_constraints, new_edges)
+
+        roots = {name: tuple(bounds) for name, bounds in data["roots"].items()}
+        search({}, roots, {})
+        return {"versions": best} if best is not None else {"error": "unsatisfiable"}
+
+    return solve

+def _route(data, coupon_rule, minimum_duration):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    initial_mask = sum(1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)
+                       if node == data["source"])
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    start = data["start"]
+    start_state = (data["source"], initial_mask, 0)
+    distances = {start_state: start}
+    queue = [(start, data["source"], initial_mask, 0)]
+    while queue:
+        time, node, mask, used = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, used)
+        if distances.get(state) != time:
+            continue
+        if (node == data["target"] and mask == full and
+                (coupon_rule != "exact" or used == data["coupons"])):
+            return {"arrival": time}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(time, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            options = [(edge["duration"], used)]
+            if used < data["coupons"]:
+                duration = max(minimum_duration,
+                               edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                options.append((duration, used + 1))
+            next_mask = mask
+            for i, required_node in enumerate(required):
+                if required_node == edge["v"]:
+                    next_mask |= 1 << i
+            for duration, next_used in options:
+                arrival = depart + duration
+                if arrival > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                next_state = (edge["v"], next_mask, next_used)
+                if arrival < distances.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    distances[next_state] = arrival
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (arrival, *next_state))

+def _route(policy, data):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bit = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    source = data["source"]
+    initial_mask = bit.get(source, 0)
+    budget = data["coupons"]
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    start = data["start"]
+    initial = (source, initial_mask, 0)
+    best = {initial: start}
+    queue = [(start, source, initial_mask, 0)]
+    deadline = data["deadline"]
+
+    while queue:
+        arrival, node, mask, used = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, used)
+        if best.get(state) != arrival:
+            continue
+        if (node == data["target"] and mask == full and
+                (policy != "exact" or used == budget)):
+            return {"arrival": arrival}
+
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(arrival, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            choices = [(edge["duration"], used)]
+            if used < budget:
+                duration = max(policy[1], edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                choices.append((duration, used + 1))
+            for duration, next_used in choices:
+                next_time = depart + duration
+                if next_time > deadline:
+                    continue
+                dest = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask | bit.get(dest, 0)
+                next_state = (dest, next_mask, next_used)
+                if next_time < best.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    best[next_state] = next_time
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (next_time, dest, next_mask, next_used))

+            reachable.add(name)
+            pending.extend(graph[name])
+        if reachable != set(installed):
+            continue
+
+        key = tuple(installed[name]["version"] if name in installed else -1
+                    for name in names)
+        if best_key is None or key < best_key:
+            best_key = key
+            best_versions = {name: row["version"] for name, row in installed.items()}
+
+    if best_versions is None:
+        return {"error": "unsatisfiable"}
+    return {"versions": best_versions}
+
+
+def _jobs(data):
+    jobs = [job for job in data["jobs"]
+            if job["id"] not in data.get("blocked", [])]
+    k = data["k"]
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+
+    for subset in combinations(jobs, k):
+        ids = {job["id"] for job in subset}
+        if not mandatory <= ids:
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in subset:
+            counts[job["group"]] = counts.get(job["group"], 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+               for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+
+        ordered = sorted(subset, key=lambda job: (job["start"], job["end"]))
+        if any(ordered[i - 1]["end"] > ordered[i]["start"]
+               for i in range(1, len(ordered))):
+            continue
+
+        value = sum(job["value"] for job in subset)
+        selected = tuple(sorted(ids))
+        if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                (value == best_value and selected > best_ids)):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, selected
+
+    if best_value is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": list(best_ids), "value": best_value}
+
+
+def _routes(data):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bit_for = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    source = data["source"]
+    coupons = data["coupons"]
+    initial_mask = bit_for.get(source, 0)
+    start_state = (source, coupons, initial_mask)
+    distances = {start_state: data["start"]}
+    queue = [(data["start"], source, coupons, initial_mask)]
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    while queue:
+        time, node, remaining, mask = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, remaining, mask)
+        if distances.get(state) != time:
+            continue
+        if node == data["target"] and remaining == 0 and mask == full:
+            return {"arrival": time}
+
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(time, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            options = [(edge["duration"], remaining)]
+            if remaining:
+                options.append((max(1, edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0)),
+                                remaining - 1))
+            for duration, next_remaining in options:
+                arrival = depart + duration
+                if arrival > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                next_node = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask | bit_for.get(next_node, 0)
+                next_state = (next_node, next_remaining, next_mask)
+                if arrival < distances.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    distances[next_state] = arrival
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (arrival, next_node, next_remaining, next_mask))
+
+    return {"arrival": None}

+def _routes(data, minimum_duration, exact):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bit = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    source = data["source"]
+    initial_mask = bit.get(source, 0)
+    coupons = data["coupons"]
+    start = data["start"]
+    # State tracks used coupons and visited requirements as well as the node.
+    initial = (source, initial_mask, 0)
+    best = {initial: start}
+    queue = [(start, source, initial_mask, 0)]
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    while queue:
+        arrival, node, mask, used = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, used)
+        if best.get(state) != arrival:
+            continue
+        if node == data["target"] and mask == full and (not exact or used == coupons):
+            return {"arrival": arrival}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(arrival, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            options = [(edge["duration"], used)]
+            if used < coupons:
+                duration = max(minimum_duration,
+                               edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                options.append((duration, used + 1))
+            for duration, next_used in options:
+                next_time = depart + duration
+                if next_time > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                next_node = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask | bit.get(next_node, 0)
+                next_state = (next_node, next_mask, next_used)
+                if next_time < best.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    best[next_state] = next_time
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (next_time, next_node, next_mask, next_used))
+    return {"arrival": None}

+import heapq
+import itertools

+def _route(data, exact, minimum_duration):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    node_masks = [0] * data["n"]
+    for i, node in enumerate(required):
+        node_masks[node] |= 1 << i
+
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    source = data["source"]
+    coupons = data["coupons"]
+    initial = (source, node_masks[source], coupons)
+    distances = {initial: data["start"]}
+    queue = [(data["start"], source, node_masks[source], coupons)]
+
+    while queue:
+        arrival, node, mask, remaining = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, remaining)
+        if distances.get(state) != arrival:
+            continue
+        if (node == data["target"] and mask == full
+                and (not exact or remaining == 0)):
+            return {"arrival": arrival}
+
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(arrival, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            ordinary_time = depart + edge["duration"]
+            options = [(ordinary_time, remaining)]
+            if remaining:
+                discounted_duration = max(
+                    minimum_duration,
+                    edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                options.append((depart + discounted_duration, remaining - 1))
+
+            for next_time, next_remaining in options:
+                if next_time > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                next_node = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask | node_masks[next_node]
+                next_state = (next_node, next_mask, next_remaining)
+                if next_time < distances.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    distances[next_state] = next_time
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (next_time, next_node, next_mask,
+                                           next_remaining))
+
+    return {"arrival": None}
+
+
+def _build_route(exact, minimum_duration):
+    return lambda data: _route(data, exact, minimum_duration)

+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))

+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+    for subset in combinations((job for job in jobs if job["id"] not in blocked), k):
+        ids = tuple(sorted(job["id"] for job in subset))
+        if not mandatory.issubset(ids):

+        counts = {}
+        for job in subset:
+            group = job["group"]
+            counts[group] = counts.get(group, 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high

+
+        active = []
+        valid = True

+def _route(data, exact, minimum):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bit = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    source = data["source"]
+    initial_mask = bit.get(source, 0)
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    start = data["start"]
+    initial = (source, initial_mask, 0)
+    best = {initial: start}
+    queue = [(start, source, initial_mask, 0)]
+    while queue:
+        arrival, node, mask, used = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, used)
+        if best.get(state) != arrival:
+            continue
+        if (node == data["target"] and mask == full and
+                (not exact or used == data["coupons"])):
+            return {"arrival": arrival}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(arrival, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            choices = [(edge["duration"], used)]
+            if used < data["coupons"]:
+                duration = max(minimum, edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                choices.append((duration, used + 1))
+            for duration, next_used in choices:
+                next_time = depart + duration
+                if next_time > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                next_node = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask | bit.get(next_node, 0)
+                next_state = (next_node, next_mask, next_used)
+                if next_time < best.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    best[next_state] = next_time
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (next_time, next_node, next_mask, next_used))
+    return {"arrival": None}

+def _dependency_solver(preference, name_order):
+    def solve(data):
+        packages = data["packages"]
+        features = set(data.get("features", []))
+        blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+        pins = data.get("pins", {})
+        names = sorted(packages, reverse=(name_order == "descending"))
+        best = None
+        best_vector = None
+
+        def active(row):
+            return [d for d in row.get("deps", [])
+                    if not d.get("feature") or d["feature"] in features]
+
+        def acyclic(versions):
+            edges = {}
+            for name, version in versions.items():
+                row = next(r for r in packages[name] if r["version"] == version)
+                edges[name] = [d["name"] for d in active(row)]
+            done, visiting = set(), set()
+
+            def visit(name):
+                if name in visiting:
+                    return False
+                if name in done:
+                    return True
+                visiting.add(name)
+                if any(not visit(other) for other in edges.get(name, [])):
+                    return False
+                visiting.remove(name)
+                done.add(name)
+                return True
+
+            return all(visit(name) for name in edges)
+
+        def search(constraints, chosen):
+            nonlocal best, best_vector
+            unresolved = [name for name in constraints if name not in chosen]
+            if not unresolved:
+                if not acyclic(chosen):
+                    return
+                vector = tuple(chosen.get(name, -1) for name in names)
+                if best is None or (vector > best_vector if preference == "maximum"
+                                    else vector < best_vector):
+                    best, best_vector = dict(chosen), vector
+                return
+
+            name = unresolved[0]
+            low, high = constraints[name]
+            rows = [r for r in packages[name]
+                    if low <= r["version"] <= high
+                    and r["version"] not in blocked.get(name, [])
+                    and (name not in pins or r["version"] == pins[name])]
+            rows.sort(key=lambda r: r["version"], reverse=(preference == "maximum"))
+            for row in rows:
+                version = row["version"]
+                next_chosen = dict(chosen)
+                next_chosen[name] = version
+                next_constraints = dict(constraints)
+                valid = True
+                for dep in active(row):
+                    other = dep["name"]
+                    lo, hi = dep["min"], dep["max"]
+                    if other in next_constraints:
+                        old_lo, old_hi = next_constraints[other]
+                        lo, hi = max(lo, old_lo), min(hi, old_hi)
+                    if lo > hi or (other in next_chosen and
+                                   not lo <= next_chosen[other] <= hi):
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                    next_constraints[other] = (lo, hi)
+                if valid:
+                    search(next_constraints, next_chosen)
+
+        roots = {name: tuple(bounds) for name, bounds in data["roots"].items()}
+        search(roots, {})
+        return {"versions": best} if best is not None else {"error": "unsatisfiable"}
+
+    return solve

+def _dependency_solver(preference, name_order):
+    def solve(data):
+        packages = data["packages"]
+        features = set(data.get("features", []))
+        blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+        pins = data.get("pins", {})
+        names = sorted(packages, reverse=(name_order == "descending"))
+        best = None
+        best_vector = None
+
+        def active(row):
+            return [d for d in row.get("deps", [])
+                    if not d.get("feature") or d["feature"] in features]
+
+        def acyclic(versions):
+            edges = {}
+            for name, version in versions.items():
+                row = next(r for r in packages[name] if r["version"] == version)
+                edges[name] = [d["name"] for d in active(row)]
+            done, visiting = set(), set()
+
+            def visit(name):
+                if name in visiting:
+                    return False
+                if name in done:
+                    return True
+                visiting.add(name)
+                if any(not visit(other) for other in edges.get(name, [])):
+                    return False
+                visiting.remove(name)
+                done.add(name)
+                return True
+
+            return all(visit(name) for name in edges)
+
+        def search(constraints, chosen):
+            nonlocal best, best_vector
+            unresolved = [name for name in constraints if name not in chosen]
+            if not unresolved:
+                if not acyclic(chosen):
+                    return
+                vector = tuple(chosen.get(name, -1) for name in names)
+                if best is None or (vector > best_vector if preference == "maximum"
+                                    else vector < best_vector):
+                    best, best_vector = dict(chosen), vector
+                return
+
+            name = unresolved[0]
+            low, high = constraints[name]
+            rows = [r for r in packages[name]
+                    if low <= r["version"] <= high
+                    and r["version"] not in blocked.get(name, [])
+                    and (name not in pins or r["version"] == pins[name])]
+            rows.sort(key=lambda r: r["version"], reverse=(preference == "maximum"))
+            for row in rows:
+                version = row["version"]
+                next_chosen = dict(chosen)
+                next_chosen[name] = version
+                next_constraints = dict(constraints)
+                valid = True
+                for dep in active(row):
+                    other = dep["name"]
+                    lo, hi = dep["min"], dep["max"]
+                    if other in next_constraints:
+                        old_lo, old_hi = next_constraints[other]
+                        lo, hi = max(lo, old_lo), min(hi, old_hi)
+                    if lo > hi or (other in next_chosen and
+                                   not lo <= next_chosen[other] <= hi):
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                    next_constraints[other] = (lo, hi)
+                if valid:
+                    search(next_constraints, next_chosen)
+

+        search(roots, {})

+def _dependency_solver(preference, name_order):
+    def solve(data):
+        packages = data["packages"]
+        features = set(data.get("features", []))
+        blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+        pins = data.get("pins", {})
+        names = sorted(packages, reverse=(name_order == "descending"))
+        best = None
+        best_vector = None
+
+        def active(row):
+            return [dep for dep in row.get("deps", [])
+                    if not dep.get("feature") or dep["feature"] in features]
+
+        def acyclic(versions):
+            edges = {}
+            for name, version in versions.items():
+                row = next(r for r in packages[name] if r["version"] == version)
+                edges[name] = [dep["name"] for dep in active(row)]
+            done, visiting = set(), set()
+
+            def visit(name):
+                if name in visiting:
+                    return False
+                if name in done:
+                    return True
+                visiting.add(name)
+                if any(not visit(other) for other in edges.get(name, [])):
+                    return False
+                visiting.remove(name)
+                done.add(name)
+                return True
+
+            return all(visit(name) for name in edges)
+
+        def search(constraints, chosen):
+            nonlocal best, best_vector
+            unresolved = [name for name in constraints if name not in chosen]
+            if not unresolved:
+                if not acyclic(chosen):
+                    return
+                vector = tuple(chosen.get(name, -1) for name in names)
+                if (best is None or
+                    (vector > best_vector if preference == "maximum"
+                     else vector < best_vector)):
+                    best, best_vector = dict(chosen), vector
+                return
+
+            name = unresolved[0]
+            low, high = constraints[name]
+            rows = [row for row in packages[name]
+                    if low <= row["version"] <= high
+                    and row["version"] not in blocked.get(name, [])
+                    and (name not in pins or row["version"] == pins[name])]
+            rows.sort(key=lambda row: row["version"],
+                      reverse=(preference == "maximum"))
+            for row in rows:
+                version = row["version"]
+                next_chosen = dict(chosen)
+                next_chosen[name] = version
+                next_constraints = dict(constraints)
+                valid = True
+                for dep in active(row):
+                    other = dep["name"]
+                    low, high = dep["min"], dep["max"]
+                    if other in next_constraints:
+                        old_low, old_high = next_constraints[other]
+                        low, high = max(low, old_low), min(high, old_high)
+                    if (low > high or
+                        (other in next_chosen and
+                         not low <= next_chosen[other] <= high)):
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                    next_constraints[other] = (low, high)
+                if valid:
+                    search(next_constraints, next_chosen)
+
+        roots = {name: tuple(bounds) for name, bounds in data["roots"].items()}
+        search(roots, {})
+        return ({"versions": best} if best is not None
+                else {"error": "unsatisfiable"})
+
+    return solve

+def _subsets(items, size):
+    # Generate fixed-size subsets without relying on order in the input.
+    n = len(items)
+    if size < 0 or size > n:
+        return
+    indices = list(range(size))
+    if size == 0:
+        yield []
+        return
+    while True:
+        yield [items[i] for i in indices]
+        i = size - 1
+        while i >= 0 and indices[i] == n - size + i:
+            i -= 1
+        if i < 0:
+            return
+        indices[i] += 1
+        for j in range(i + 1, size):

+def dependency_solver(data, preference, name_order):
+    packages = data["packages"]
+    features = set(data.get("features", []))
+    blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+    pins = data.get("pins", {})
+    constraints = {name: [tuple(bounds)] for name, bounds in data["roots"].items()}
+    solutions = []
+
+    def visit(chosen, constraints, edges):
+        pending = [n for n in constraints if n not in chosen]
+        if not pending:
+            state = {}
+            def acyclic(n):
+                if state.get(n) == 1:
+                    return False
+                if state.get(n) == 2:
+                    return True
+                state[n] = 1
+                if any(not acyclic(v) for v in edges.get(n, ())):
+                    return False
+                state[n] = 2
+                return True
+            if all(acyclic(n) for n in chosen):
+                solutions.append(chosen.copy())
+            return
+        name = pending[0]
+        lows = [b[0] for b in constraints[name]]
+        highs = [b[1] for b in constraints[name]]
+        rows = [r for r in packages[name]
+                if max(lows) <= r["version"] <= min(highs)
+                and r["version"] not in blocked.get(name, [])
+                and (name not in pins or r["version"] == pins[name])]
+        rows.sort(key=lambda r: r["version"], reverse=(preference == "maximum"))
+        for row in rows:
+            version = row["version"]
+            ch = chosen.copy()
+            ch[name] = version
+            cs = {n: list(bs) for n, bs in constraints.items()}
+            ed = {n: list(vs) for n, vs in edges.items()}
+            ed.setdefault(name, [])
+            valid = True
+            for dep in row.get("deps", []):
+                feat = dep.get("feature", "")
+                if feat and feat not in features:

+                other = dep["name"]
+                ed[name].append(other)
+                cs.setdefault(other, []).append((dep["min"], dep["max"]))
+                if other in ch and not (dep["min"] <= ch[other] <= dep["max"]):

+                    break
+            if valid:
+                visit(ch, cs, ed)
+
+    visit({}, constraints, {})
+    if not solutions:

+    names = sorted(packages, reverse=(name_order == "descending"))

+def _dependency_solver(data, order, preference):
+    packages = data["packages"]
+    names = sorted(packages)

+            for name, versions in packages.items()}
+    choices = [[None] + list(rows[name]) for name in names]
+    best_vector = None
+    best_versions = None
+
+    for values in product(*choices):
+        installed = {name: version for name, version in zip(names, values)
+                     if version is not None}
+        if any(name not in installed or not low <= installed[name] <= high
+               for name, (low, high) in data["roots"].items()):
+            continue
+        if any(name in installed and installed[name] != version
+               for name, version in pins.items()):
+            continue
+        if any(version in blocked.get(name, []) for name, version in installed.items()):
+            continue
+
+        edges = {name: [] for name in installed}

+            row = rows[name][version]
+            for dep in row.get("deps", []):

+                other = dep["name"]

+                    valid = False
+                    break
+                edges[name].append(other)
+            if not valid:

+        if not valid:
+            continue
+
+        reached = set()
+        stack = list(data["roots"])

+            continue

+        state, cyclic = {}, False
+        def visit(name):
+            nonlocal cyclic
+            if state.get(name) == 1:
+                cyclic = True
+                return
+            if state.get(name) == 2:
+                return
+            state[name] = 1
+            for other in edges[name]:
+                visit(other)
+                if cyclic:

+            visit(name)
